title: Wake Up In Salem, 1692

beats.narration: You wake up in Salem. Someone just said your name in court.
beats.shot_prompt: First-person POV waking on a straw mattress in a dark 17th-century wooden house in Massachusetts, fists pounding on the door, cold dawn light through gaps in the planks

beats.narration: It's 1692. A few girls in the village have been having strange fits, and they're naming the people they say caused them.
beats.shot_prompt: POV walking down a muddy Puritan village street in 1692, villagers in plain dark clothing turning away and avoiding eye contact, grey overcast sky

beats.narration: You're brought into a packed meeting house. There's no lawyer to defend you, and the judges are already leaning forward.
beats.shot_prompt: POV inside a crowded 1692 Puritan meeting house, wooden benches full of villagers staring, stern magistrates in black at a raised table, candlelight

beats.narration: The main evidence is what the accusers say they saw in dreams and visions. You can't prove a dream wrong.
beats.shot_prompt: POV facing young accusers in a 1692 courtroom who scream and point toward the camera, villagers gasping, dramatic candlelit shadows

beats.narration: By the end, more than two hundred people are accused, and twenty of them are executed.
beats.shot_prompt: POV at dusk watching a line of accused villagers being led away along a dirt road in 1692 Massachusetts, bare trees, fog, somber mood

beats.narration: So, how would you have proved you weren't a witch? Best answer picks where I take you tomorrow.
beats.shot_prompt: POV slowly turning back toward a 1692 wooden meeting house at night, a single lantern glowing in the window, fog rolling across the ground

facts_to_check: Salem witch trials took place in 1692 in colonial Massachusetts
Accusations began with girls having fits
More than 200 accused; 20 executed (19 hanged, 1 pressed to death)
